title: Wills, probate and intestacy - state-law boundary
facts: Wills, probate procedure, intestate succession, executor or personal-representative powers and most creditor-claim deadlines are primarily matters of state law.
There is no single federal rule stating who inherits an estate when a U.S. resident dies without a will.
Federal tax, Social Security, retirement-plan and benefit rules can affect an estate without replacing state probate law.
Hanka should identify the decedent's state of domicile and, for real estate, the property's location before giving a specific probate or intestacy answer.
